name: codex-loop-harness
description: Bootstrap loop state with a managed goal hook before loop or goal work, then run evidence-gated Supervisor-Worker phases with research skill orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap goals and run evidence-gated loops.
interface.longDescription: Codex Loop Harness uses a managed pre-prompt goal hook to initialize and validate .ai-loop before loop or goal work, then links research skills, starts bounded phases, collects evidence, prepares audits, validates gates, and recovers loop state.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Loop Harness to initialize this project.
Create a goal after bootstrapping the loop in this repository.
Use Codex Loop Harness to start a physics-research phase.
Use Codex Loop Harness to audit the current phase evidence.
